stem.text: A transverse wave and a longitudinal wave both travel in the same direction down a long stretched spring.
Which statement is **not** correct for these two forms of wave?

A.text: The displacement measurements for the particles of the two waves are made at right angles to each other.

B.text: The energy transferred by the two waves is in the same direction.

C.text: The velocities of the two waves are in the same direction.

D.text: The wavelength measurements for the two waves are made at right angles to each other.
